critique: The warm orange, softly glowing points on black read as fireflies and the centered swarm composition is plausible. However, the swarm is a tight, nearly static-looking square cluster: between t1 and t4 it mostly refreshes dot positions rather than showing visible individual flight. It lacks the broader, organic dispersion and lingering, wandering swarm motion expected from a “Swarm Fireflies” magic preset.

suggestions.why: Give particles visible travel between frames so the swarm reads as flying fireflies rather than a stationary emitter cloud.
Add substantial speed variation so individual fireflies drift at different rates instead of moving as a uniform mass.
Let moving particles remain visible longer, creating a more persistent, naturally dispersed swarm.
